verdict.rationale: Postmark exposes much of a user's data through its REST APIs. Messages can be searched and retrieved, templates can be listed, and bounces and delivery/open/click stats are queryable. A user could script an export of messages, templates, bounces and stats. However, there is no documented export or data-portability feature, and activity data is only retained for 45 days by default (up to 365 with a paid add-on), which caps what can ever be taken out. missing for 10: a dedicated bulk/full-account export, explicit open-format export documentation, migration/offboarding guidance, independent corroboration that complete exports are feasible.
